equivalenceAudit: Before admitting ANY positive, render all single-position Il1/O0 alternatives in its exact registered condition as audit-only counterfactuals. If distinct targets have identical normalizedFP32 input, exclude ALL members of the physical equivalence unit from CTC; do not retain whichever label rendered first and do not invent a negative/damage label. Generate replacement units deterministically before freeze. Audit again globally across all positives/negatives for PNG/input/CNN-feature contradictions; exclude all conflicting update rows, no label repair. Record attempted/rejected units and font balance.
